name: townhouse-savanna
description: Burgher's Townhouse, the savanna look (ROADMAP 49.10b): the shipped Townhouse drawn again as a trader's house: a red granite storey behind a veranda, a mud-and-acacia hall storey, one great thatch hip, a wing under its own hip and a thatched lookout tower.
